# discord_application_emoji (Resource)

Manages an emoji owned by an application, which its bot can use in any server, up to 2000 per application. Discord cannot change an emoji's image, so a new image uploads a new emoji.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_application_emoji" "check" {
  name  = "check"
  image = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/check.png")}"
}

# With Terraform 1.11 or later, image_wo keeps the image out of state. Bump
# image_wo_version to upload a new emoji.
resource "discord_application_emoji" "cross" {
  name             = "cross"
  image_wo         = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/cross.png")}"
  image_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Emoji name (2-32 letters, digits or underscores), unique within the application.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application. Defaults to the application the provider's bot token belongs to, the only one it can manage.
- `image` (String) Image as a data URI (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 128x128, at most 256 KiB), e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("emoji.png")}"`. Changing the image uploads a new emoji. Stored in state; prefer `image_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Exactly one of `image` and `image_wo` is required.
- `image_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Image as a data URI (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 128x128, at most 256 KiB). Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `image_wo_version`. Conflicts with `image`.
- `image_wo_version` (Number) Version of `image_wo`. Changing it uploads `image_wo` as a new emoji.

### Read-Only

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is animated.
- `id` (String) Emoji ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_application_emoji.check
  identity = {
    application_id = "456789012345678901"
    emoji_id       = "567890123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application.
- `emoji_id` (String) ID of the emoji.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_application_emoji.check <application_id>/<emoji_id>
```
